context_notes: Phase 3 (VLA Inference Loop) is functionally very close to done — the hard engineering (shared VLABackend interface, OFTBackend, eval_loop, Pi0Backend, both notebooks, three real bugs found+fixed via live Colab debugging — two in OFT's path during 03-02, one config-name-drift bug in π0's path during 03-03 Task 4, fixed via quick task 260726-epz on 2026-07-26) is complete and verified for the OFT path. Only π0's Task 4 checkpoint (re-run with the fix applied) stands between here and phase completion. Discovered mid-session: this repo's LIBERO/ is its own nested git repo, entirely gitignored by the main repo, but on case-insensitive macOS a pre-existing (Phase 1) convention has files landing under a lowercase 'libero/' path tracked by the MAIN repo's git (not LIBERO's own git) — this is accepted/pre-existing, not something to 'fix' mid-phase. Also discovered: Colab kernels cache Python module imports across cell re-runs — re-syncing a fixed source file via the unzip cell does NOT reload already-imported modules; a genuine Runtime > Restart session is required, not just re-running cells. This caused one confusing false-repeat-error round-trip during debugging; flagged as advisory for any future Colab debugging in this project. New lesson from 260726-epz: openpi tracks main with no pinned release — its LIBERO config names (pi0_fast_libero/pi0_libero) were deprecated in favor of pi05_libero between plan-time and first live run; re-verify openpi's serve_policy.py/README/config.py directly against source before trusting any previously-researched config name if this project's openpi checkout advances again.
